facts.text: Miraval Arizona is set across 400 acres of the Sonoran Desert.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Miraval Arizona, set across 400 acres of serene Sonoran Desert under nearly year-round sunshine.

facts.text: The resort stretches against the Santa Catalina Mountains just north of Tucson.
facts.excerpt: The resort is spread across 400 acres of Sonoran Desert, stretching against the Santa Catalina mountains just north of Tucson.

facts.text: The grounds have cacti, flowering ocotillo and prickly pear, and mesquite and acacia trees.
facts.excerpt: Ancient cacti stand tall, flowering ocotillo and prickly pear add bursts of color, and mesquite and acacia trees offer cool shade

facts.text: All meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies and non-alcoholic beverages are included, with an additional charge for premium zero-proof cocktails.
facts.excerpt: That's right, all meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies, and non-alcoholic beverages are included, Additional charge for hand-crafted, premium Zero Proof Cocktails.

facts.text: Stays include a nightly resort credit that can be applied to spa services, fee-based activities or private sessions.
facts.excerpt: Resort credit can be applied to spa services, fee-based activities, or private sessions

facts.text: Miraval is a gratuity-free resort.
facts.excerpt: No tips needed. Miraval is a gratuity-free resort

facts.text: Stays include shared shuttle ground transportation from Tucson International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Ground, shared shuttle transportation from Tucson International Airport

facts.text: Miraval welcomes guests aged 18 and older.
facts.excerpt: Miraval welcomes guests who are 18+ years or older.

facts.text: Stays include full access to the Life in Balance Spa.
facts.excerpt: Full access to the Life in Balance Spa

facts.text: The Vasudhara spa service combines Thai stretches, bodywork and a warm water float.
facts.excerpt: This transformative service eases muscles with Thai stretches, bodywork, and a gravity-defying warm water float.

facts.text: Spa treatments range from acupuncture to Ayurveda to water-based sessions in a private pool.
facts.excerpt: Everything from a long acupuncture list to Ayurveda to water-based sessions in a private pool.

facts.text: Activities range from equine and outdoor adventure experiences to yoga, meditation and breathwork, many of them complimentary.
facts.excerpt: We offer an extensive menu of daily workshops, classes, lectures, and activities, many of which are complimentary.

facts.text: Guests can hike up Mt. Lemmon, try therapeutic drumming and spend time with horses at Purple Sage Ranch.
facts.excerpt: Go hiking up Mt. Lemmon, try therapeutic drumming, spend an afternoon bonding with our equine friends at Purple Sage Ranch.

facts.text: Experiences include aerial yoga, the Sky Island Traverse challenge course, archery and Sonoran stargazing.
facts.excerpt:
Challenge Course

Sky Island Traverse

facts.text: Most activities are available as private one-on-one sessions with specialists.
facts.excerpt: Most of our activities are available as private sessions, which give you the opportunity to work one-on-one with our world-class specialists

facts.text: Miraval Immersions are multi-day masterclass programs created by specialists.
facts.excerpt: Explore your wellness goals or specific intentions with exclusive multi-day masterclass programs created by expert specialists.

facts.text: Guest rooms have in-room meditation channels and a Himalayan singing bowl.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy personal time with in-room meditation channels, and your Himalayan singing bowl.

facts.text: The Retreats have at least 600 square feet, an indoor/outdoor shower and a patio with a private in-ground hot tub.
facts.excerpt: With at least 600 square feet of space, these come with a spacious indoor/outdoor shower along with a patio where a bubbling, private in-ground hot tub awaits.

facts.text: Accommodation ranges from standard rooms to multi-bedroom villas.
facts.excerpt: Accommodation options range from a standard room to multi-bedroom villas for the ultimate indulgence.

facts.text: Most of the property is a screen-free zone, and guests receive a linen sleeping bag for storing digital devices.
facts.excerpt: Miraval welcomes everyone checking in with a linen sleeping bag for storing digital devices, and the majority of the property is set up as a screen-free zone.

facts.text: Miraval was created in the mid-1990s on a former ranch that had housed the Sierra Tucson treatment facility, and is now part of Hyatt.
facts.excerpt: After Sierra Tucson downsized and relocated in the mid-‘90s, O’Donnell decided to branch out beyond addiction, and thus Miraval was created.

facts.text: The resort sits almost an hour from Tucson International Airport, surrounded by older homes and horse properties.
facts.excerpt: Older homes and horse properties surround Miraval, which sits miles away from Interstate 10 and almost an hour from Tucson International Airport.

facts.text: Miraval operates on 100% renewable energy.
facts.excerpt: Miraval operates on 100% renewable energy.

facts.text: At Cactus Flower, dinner requires a reservation and offers a seasonally changing a la carte menu.
facts.excerpt: dinner, however, requires a reservation and includes à la carte menu items that change seasonally.

facts.text: Just Cook For Me is an intimate dining experience in the heart of Miraval's kitchen, with dishes paired with wine.
facts.excerpt: Sample the culinary creations of our talented chefs with our most intimate dining experience in the heart of Miraval’s kitchen.

facts.text: The Life in Balance Spa was recently renovated with a minimalist design and indoor and outdoor relaxation space.
facts.excerpt: Recently renovated, the spa has a soothing and minimalist design that provides ample indoor and outdoor space to relax in pre- and post-treatment

facts.text: Guests may check in as early as 11 a.m., though rooms may not be ready until several hours later.
facts.excerpt: Guests are encouraged to check in as early as 11 a.m. on the day of arrival to enjoy lunch and get a jump start on all of the activities.
